# Part 13 · Your Agent's Errors Return 200

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdT-hkURufh/) · Published 15 Sep 2026

> Why does your retry logic never fire when the agent is wrong?

The agent's answer is wrong, the status is 200, the JSON is valid, and nothing retries. Checking whether it's true takes another model call, which costs about as much as the answer.

![Whiteboard for Part 13](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Ration "is this true?" checks. Each one is another model call.
2. Check that every id and number in the output came from the input. It's a string operation, and it catches invention.
3. Spend the second model call only where the action can't be undone.
